name: Philologus
overview: Philologus is a male figure mentioned in the New Testament to whom the Apostle Paul sends greetings in Romans 16:15. Beyond this brief mention, Scripture does not provide additional details about his tribe or personal background. His inclusion in Paul's greetings indicates he was a recognized member of the early Christian community.
